description: Enforced field set and enums for a host-neutral, evidence-bound composite-decision record. Single source read by scripts/validate_composite_decision.py; the prose composite-decision-record.schema.md documents intent and rules and does not restate these lists. Procedural rules (at least two dimensions; each dimension named and levelled; WEIGHTED requires a positive weight per dimension; MIN/MAX fix the composite to the extreme level; WEIGHTED bounds the composite within the dimension levels; no VERIFIED assurance) stay in the validator. Adapts TypeSafe/Jev's 'decompose into atomic questions and combine with an explicit rule' discipline, keeping levels qualitative rather than importing a calibrated number.
